name: tiddlywiki-lsp
description: Completion, hover, go to definition, references, outline, folding, signature help, inlay hints and rename for .tid files, served by a TiddlyWiki --lsp process the editor starts for the wiki.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: In an untrusted workspace the command in tiddlywiki.info is not run; the extension only connects to a wiki already started with --lsp.

tiddlywiki.lsp.host.description: Host the TiddlyWiki --lsp server listens on.

tiddlywiki.lsp.port.description: Port of the wiki's --lsp server. Leave unset to read it from the .tw-mcp/lsp file the running wiki writes in its folder.

tiddlywiki.lsp.wiki.description: Wiki folder the editor starts an LSP server for when no workspace folder's tiddlywiki.info has an lsp section. Absolute, `${workspaceFolder}/editions/tw5.com-server`, `${workspaceFolder:<name>}/...` in a multi-root workspace, or relative to the first workspace folder.

tiddlywiki.lsp.command.description: Command that boots tiddlywiki.lsp.wiki. The wiki folder and --lsp pipe=<name> are appended, e.g. `tiddlywiki +plugins/wikilabs/tw-mcp-core +plugins/wikilabs/tw-mcp`.

tiddlywiki.lsp.label.description: Label of the LSP server started for tiddlywiki.lsp.wiki, shown in its log and the MCP server's. Empty means lsp-<wiki folder name>, e.g. lsp-tw5.com-server.

commands.title: TiddlyWiki LSP: Reconnect to the wiki
